integrity: Finite enumeration by exact Jacobian ideals, independent symbolic checking, additive Fourier counts, and complete projective orbit representatives; executable code and tables embedded.
scientific_limitations: Counts embedded O(2,3) pencils up to the ruling-preserving 36-element projective group, not abstract genus-two isomorphism classes; geometric common-base scheme structure beyond intersection number 12 is not determined; worldwide priority and external independent verification are not established.
title: Exact smooth genus-two pencils on a binary split quadric
